text: Owner review round 1 (2026-09-15): not acceptable that each list carries its own style. Root cause: the F06 surfaces used raw ListItem while the rest of the app uses the design system's WloListRow — three visible anatomies (F06 logbook inline headline, History's ragged one/two-line mix, Plan's standard row). Unification: History buckets and logbook rows now go through WloListRow, so every list in the app shares one anatomy — headline, always-present supporting meta line (uniform row rhythm; counts now render always, singular included), trailing value slot; dividers only inside flat groups (logbook, diary), group headers elsewhere (History tiers, Plan day cards). Logbook swipe wrapper unchanged: the page-colored mask box sits around the WloListRow so the reveal still reads as one opaque sliding piece. Verified on the emulator: History, Logbook and Plan lists now read identically. Commit 86ecafa.

Visual comparison pass (2026-09-15, owner request): History card vs logbook measured on-device — identical after one fix. Matching: row anatomy (headline 47px / supporting 41px / value 47px), 16dp insets relative to each container (x84 on the page, x123 in the card; values right-aligned at 996/957), two-line pitch 214px vs 210px, group headers at container padding one level left of row content. Fixed: History rows had no dividers while the logbook did — hairlines now separate rows within a tier, captions mark tier boundaries. Intentionally different: History trailing adds the Δ column (summary), logbook value-only (verbatim); header duty differs (tier labels vs month + facts). Commit on main.
